sample.evidence: The original shows four full-width tile rows, a six-chest horizontal row with recessed shoulders, and six pink-shell rows below. Tall numbered brown containers occupy the lower field's left upper and right lower edges. This supports the candidate's layered_bands and its explicit rejection of a complete separating gap; the shoulder recesses do not divide the grid.

The match grid has single-cell high outer shoulders and successive one-cell downward steps toward a central top recess. Pale wrapped round pieces follow those steps, with more scattered among lower tiles, and the bottom grid edge is straight. stair_step describes the actual playable top boundary, not a blocker staircase. The treasure chest in the recess and brick arena with a 17 counter below are outside the match grid, consistent with the candidate's separation of the arena.

An outlined upper-center rectangle contains two blue structures, with visible treasure-background space beneath it before the lower grid begins. Both outer columns contain stacked cream-and-purple paw-marked jars, not figurines as the candidate states. Wrapped round pieces and colored tiles occupy the lower field, and a green curtain marked 30 hides its bottom center. split_regions and layered_bands are supported for the visible arrangement, but the object description needs correction and the curtain prevents inspection of its interior.

candidate_correction.observation: Two blue structures occupy a separate upper-center rectangle above a visible background gap. Stacked paw-marked jars form the outer columns of the lower board; colored tiles and pale wrapped round pieces occupy its exposed center. A green curtain marked 30 conceals the bottom-center interior.

Outer rails contain discs on the upper-left and lower-right fields and striped pieces on the other two. split_regions and the candidate's holes are supported; 'alternate' is valid across island rails, not as alternation within each individual rail.

limitations: This is a bounded independent sample of 12 available original images, not proof of correctness of the whole 8001-9000 batch. Results are 7 supported, 5 conflict, and 0 uncertain; supported means the sampled visible claims, not an accepted classification.

The first, middle, and last available records were selected within each shard using the lower median of the available-record sequence: 8001/8136/8252, 8253/8378/8504, 8505/8627/8750, and 8776/8888/9000. The third shard ends with missing sources, so its last available record is 8750; the tail starts with missing sources, so its first available record is 8776. Twelve distinct originals were rendered directly; contact sheets were not substituted for originals.
The index reports 953 available sources and 47 missing levels across the batch. Missing levels were excluded from this visual sample and receive no inferred board description.

All 1000 candidate records retain integer schema_version 2 and review_status needs_review. This report also remains needs_review. Candidate shards, source images, pilot, apps, manifests, historical batches, and trackers were not edited; conflicts and proposed corrections remain alongside the original candidates only in this report.

Royal Kingdom v1 supplies candidate geometry vocabulary for Royal Match, not an accepted Match taxonomy. Visible occupied blockers do not prove disconnected regions; stair_step requires steps in the playable boundary, central_mass describes occupied coverage, and boss arenas remain separate from match grids.
Opaque curtain and panel interiors at 8252 and 8627 cannot be inspected from these screenshots. Supported visible arrangements do not establish hidden cells, gameplay connectivity, or mechanics.

Every sampled candidate has unknown verified difficulty and strategy, empty verified_evidence, and null difficulty_hypothesis and strategy_hypothesis. No directly cited local evidence was supplied to justify changing those fields; this report adds no difficulty or strategy inference.

validation.json reports repeated_observations as an empty list. An independent exact-text count of observations for all 953 available candidates also found no duplicates. Missing-source boilerplate was excluded. Repeated generic wording such as tile fields, lower blocks, and candidate-vocabulary caveats is not proof of inspection; unique wording likewise does not prove accuracy, as the sampled object/count conflicts demonstrate.
Structural validation and matching hashes verify provenance and record shape, not visual fidelity. Proposed corrections are visible-description suggestions only, not promotions or accepted labels.
